blocks.text: sp3 hybridization mein ek s orbital (kam energy, kurrawi) aur teen p orbitals (zyada energy, dumb-bell shakal) mil kar ek jaisi energy aur shakal ke chaar orbitals ka naya set dete hain, har ek sp3 hybrid orbital, jo CH4 ki tarah tetrahedral geometry mein tarteeb pate hain. Carbon ground state mein 2s2 2px1 2py1 2pz1 hai; excited state mein ek 2s electron oopar jata hai, jo 2s1 2px1 2py1 2pz1 deta hai; phir chaar sab se bairooni orbitals chaar sp3 hybrids mein milte hain, har ek mein ek electron. Hybrid orbitals ki energies ghair-hybrid p orbitals se kam hain. Har sp3 hybrid ke do lobes hain, ek bara aur ek chhota; asani ke liye chhota lobe aam taur par nahi dikhaya jata. Barabar energy ke chaar hybrids ki tetrahedral geometry hai jis ke markaz mein carbon nucleus hai. Methane sp3 hybrids ke chaar hydrogen atoms ke 1s orbitals se overlap se banta hai, sp3-s overlap se chaar sigma bonds jo ba-qaida tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hain.

blocks.alt: Carbon ke orbital dabbe teen qataron mein. 6C ground: 2s mein do ulte teer, 2px aur 2py mein ek ek oopar teer, 2pz khaali (Ground). C excited: 2s, 2px, 2py aur 2pz har ek mein ek oopar teer (Excited). C hybridized: chaar sp3 dabbe, har ek mein ek oopar teer (hybridized).
blocks.caption: Carbon ke electron dabbe: ground, excited aur sp3 hybridized haalat (kitab ke chhape box diagrams ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ground state mein carbon ke sirf do akele electrons hain, magar woh chaar bonds banata hai. Is liye ek 2s electron khaali 2pz mein chala jata hai (excited state), aur phir yeh chaar orbitals mil kar chaar barabar sp3 orbitals bana dete hain, har ek mein ek electron.

blocks.alt: Oopar: 2s orbital (+ wala gola) jama 2px, 2py aur 2pz orbitals, har ek x, y, z mehwaron par dumb-bell, ek khaake wala lobe + ke saath. Neeche: 'Shape of one sp3 orbital having two lobes', ek chhota aur ek bara lobe, aur 'Four sp3 hybrid orbitals', tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf chaar lobes.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.27: Methane mein C ke sp3 hybrid orbitals ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: sp2 hybridization mein atom ke ek s aur do p orbitals mil kar teen sp2 hybrid orbitals banate hain. Teen aadhe bhare sp2 hybrids 120 degrees ke bond zawiyon ke saath trigonal planar geometry mein tarteeb pate hain. Yeh BF3 jaise musattah molecules ki geometry samjhata hai. Boron ground state mein 2s2 2px1 hai; excited ho kar 2s1 2px1 2py1; teen sab se bairooni orbitals mil kar teen sp2 hybrids dete hain, ek p orbital ghair-istemal reh jata hai. Fluorine ka ek p orbital aadha bhara hai (maslan 2pz), aur BF3 boron ke teen aadhe bhare sp2 hybrids ke teen fluorine atoms ke 2pz orbitals se overlap se banta hai; banawat trigonal planar hai jis ke bond zawiye 120 degrees hain.

blocks.alt: 2s orbital jama 2px orbital jama 2py orbital mehwaron par, 'Hybridization' likha teer, aur ek plane mein teen sp2 lobes, muRa dohra teer 120 degrees. Neeche daen: 'Shape of one sp2 orbital', + wala chhota lobe aur bara lobe.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.29: Atomic orbitals se sp2 hybrid orbitals ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.29 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Boron ke orbital dabbe teen qataron mein. 5B ground: 2s mein do ulte teer, 2px mein ek oopar teer, 2py aur 2pz khaali. B excited: 2s, 2px aur 2py mein ek ek oopar teer, 2pz khaali. B hybridized: teen sp2 dabbe, har ek mein ek oopar teer.
blocks.caption: Boron ke electron dabbe: ground, excited aur sp2 hybridized haalat (kitab ke chhape box diagrams ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: (a) Boron atom ke teen bhoore sp2 lobes 120 degrees par, har ek fluorine atom ke neele 2pz orbital se overlap karta hai; sp2, F aur 2pz likha. (b) BF3 ki lakeeri tasveer: B teen F atoms se jura, F atoms ko milata dotted tikon, aur 120 degrees ka zawiya.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.30: sp2-p overlap se BF3 molecule ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.30 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: sp hybridization mein ek s orbital (kam energy, kurrawi) aur ek p orbital (zyada energy, dumb-bell shakal) mil kar ek jaisi energy aur shakal ke do orbitals dete hain, sp hybrids, jo 180 degrees par khatti tarteeb mein hain. Beryllium ground state mein 2s2 hai; excited ho kar 2s1 2px1; dono mil kar do sp hybrids dete hain jo ek lakeer mein hain. Yeh beryllium chloride, BeCl2, jaise linear molecules ki geometry samjhata hai, jo beryllium ke do sp hybrids ke do chlorine atoms ke aadhe bhare p orbitals se overlap se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Beryllium ke orbital dabbe teen qataron mein. 4Be ground: 2s mein do ulte teer, teenon 2p dabbe khaali. Be excited: 2s aur 2px mein ek ek oopar teer, 2py aur 2pz khaali. Be hybridized: do sp dabbe, har ek mein ek oopar teer.
blocks.caption: Beryllium ke electron dabbe: ground, excited aur sp hybridized haalat (kitab ke chhape box diagrams ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Oopar: s orbital jama p orbital, 'Hybridization' likha teer, 'Two sp hybrid orbitals' ulti simton mein, aur 'sp hybrid orbitals shown together (Large lobes only)'. Neeche: Cl ke p orbitals Be ke do sp lobes se ek seedh mein overlap karte hain, 180 degrees, jo Cl-Be-Cl 180 degrees ke barabar hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.32: s aur p orbitals ka mil kar do sp hybrid orbitals dena aur BeCl2 ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.32 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: NH3 aur CO2 mein orbital hybridization aur har ek se banne wali shakal ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: NH3 mein nitrogen apne 2s aur teen 2p orbitals ko chaar sp3 hybrids mein milata hai; teen mein ek ek electron hai jo hydrogen 1s orbitals se overlap karte hain, chautha lone pair rakhta hai, to molecule 109.5 degrees se thora kam zawiyon wala trigonal pyramid hai. CO2 mein carbon apne 2s ko ek 2p se mila kar 180 degrees par do sp hybrids banata hai, jo do oxygens se sigma bonds banate hain, jabke us ke baqi do p orbitals double bonds ke pi bonds banate hain; molecule linear hai.

items: sp3: ek s + teen p, chaar hybrids, tetrahedral, 109.5 degrees (CH4 sp3-s overlap se); hybrids energy mein p se neeche hain aur bara aur chhota lobe rakhte hain.
sp2: ek s + do p, teen hybrids, trigonal planar, 120 degrees (BF3 sp2-p overlap se, ek p ghair-istemal). sp: ek s + ek p, do hybrids, linear, 180 degrees (BeCl2 sp-p overlap se).
